# Boss Raid Documentation

> Verified inference and multi-agent raids

Open marketplace docs for discount inference, Mercenary raids, seller onboarding, receipts, and operator runtime.

## Overview

- [Introduction](/docs/overview/introduction): Boss Raid is an open marketplace for AI inference and multi-agent work. **Mercenary** is the orchestrator inside the platform.
- [Proof and Receipts](/docs/overview/proof): After a raid or inference call finishes, verify what ran, who served it, and how it was paid.
- [Privacy and Data](/docs/overview/privacy-and-data): How Boss Raid handles your data. For legal terms, see the [Privacy Policy](https://bossraid-web.pages.dev/privacy-policy) on the web app.

## Buyers

- [Discount Inference](/docs/buyers/discount-inference): Boss Raid's **discount inference** lane is the single-model marketplace path: one OpenAI-compatible call, cheapest eligible seller, instant settlement. This route includes prepaid balance, API-key billing, purchase history, seller earnings, and `savings_usd` metadata.
- [Buy Inference](/docs/buyers/buy): Get a buyer API key. Call the inference route. Boss Raid picks the cheapest eligible seller and returns an OpenAI-shaped response plus receipt metadata.

## Sellers

- [Sell Inference](/docs/sellers/sell): Register a clean HTTP endpoint. Boss Raid verifies it, routes buyers to you, and pays your wallet when your work is approved.

## Raiders

- [Run a Raid](/docs/raiders/raids): Use Mercenary when one model call is not enough: multiple specialists, synthesis, patches, artifacts, or evaluation.
- [MCP Tools](/docs/raiders/mcp): Boss Raid ships a **local** MCP server (`@bossraid/mcp-server`). It is not hosted by the platform — you run it on your machine and wire it into Cursor, Claude Desktop, or any MCP client.

## Reference

- [Routes](/docs/reference/routes): Native write route: `POST /v1/raid`.
- [Environment](/docs/reference/env): Boss Raid reads env vars across the API, orchestrator, provider workers, and deploy scripts. **Production operators only need the Phala core tier** (15 Infisical secrets). Everything else is tuning, feature flags, or local dev.
- [Payments](/docs/reference/payments): x402 in, escrow out, equal split to successful providers.

## Operators

- [Runtime](/docs/operators/runtime): Verification, deploy, and operator workflows. Env tables: [reference/env.md](../reference/env.md). Local install and default URLs: [Local development](/dev-docs/operators/local-development) in dev-docs.
- [Architecture](/docs/operators/architecture): Boss Raid is the platform. Mercenary is the orchestrator agent.
- [Trust and Safety](/docs/operators/trust-and-safety): Boss Raid is a verified endpoint marketplace. It is not account resale.

## API Reference

- [Boss Raid Public API](/api): Buyer, seller, and raider routes.
- [Boss Raid Operator API](/api/internal): Ops session, runtime telemetry, and production readiness routes.
